items.description: Open-source AI job search agent and job finder: scan job boards, score each job 1-5 against your CV before you apply, tailor an ATS-friendly resume and cover letter, get interview prep and an application tracker. It helps you fill in each application; you press Submit. Runs locally in Codex, OpenCode and other AI CLIs, or as a Claude Code plugin.
A persistent workspace for development work that self-improves and continues beyond one session.

Autonomous AI sales agent powered by Claude Code or Codex. Finds prospects, writes cold emails, sends campaigns, handles replies, books meetings. No API keys needed — runs on your Claude or Codex subscriptions.
Open-source, self-hosted customer support desk in a single binary. A lightweight alternative to Intercom, Zendesk, Chatwoot.
Every past session, subagent, and workflow -- queryable by your agent, browsable by you
Curated systems, benchmarks, and papers etc. on memory for LLMs/MLLMs --- long-term context, retrieval, and reasoning.
⚡ Pi, the coding agent, compiled ahead of time to one native executable. 10× faster to start, 7× less CPU and 4.5× less memory than Pi on Node. Linux, macOS, Windows, ARM64 and Android (Termux).

mu (μ): most of what a coding agent decides isn't code. mu hands 40 kinds of yes/no calls to a small model: fewer wasted tokens, fewer approvals on autopilot, fewer runs that stop halfway. Built on pi.
